Press Release:

Season three of “Silo” continues the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances, while revealing an origin story set centuries earlier. In the present, Juliette Nichols (Rebecca Ferguson) survives her forced “cleaning” but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the “Before Times,” journalist Helen Drew (Jessica Henwick) and Congressman Daniel Keene (Ashley Zukerman) uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences. The series is based on Hugh Howey’s New York Times bestselling trilogy, “Silo.”

snippet.title: Simulating a Criminal Empire on Hardcore Minecraft
snippet.description:
Me and my friends spent two weeks running a realistic Minecraft society server, and then removed every rule for one night. This modded Minecraft SMP had a real election with candidates and campaign promises, property tax and income tax, a town treasury, insurance you buy from the mayor, a sheriff with search warrants, DNA forensics that can tell you who placed a block, and consequences for anyone who fell behind. Miss your taxes and your base starts crumbling around you. Then on the final night the server flips to hardcore Minecraft, the laws stop applying, and everyone finds out what we knew from day one: every single player secretly drew a name at the start, and one of them drew mine. Almost four hours of Minecraft roleplay, elections, creative accounting, trail cameras, tape recorders, a courthouse, a rollercoaster, and one rare item that took the whole town apart before the final night even arrived.

snippet.title: By Any Means | Final Trailer (2026 Movie) – Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Mark Wahlberg
snippet.description:
Fight fire with fury, by any means necessary. Based on a true story, watch the Final Trailer for #ByAnyMeansMovie, only in theaters September 4.

Inspired by a true story, a young Black FBI agent (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II) is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa (Mark Wahlberg), he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.
When the system is broken, two men divided by everything agree on one thing: the law has limits. They don’t.

snippet.title: Harry Potter Isn't Book-Accurate Anymore
snippet.description:
Grab a cold one, ya pelicans. Today we’re sitting down to rip into the brand-new HBO Harry Potter trailer shot-by-shot.
First they promised us an adaptation strictly "faithful" to the sacred texts—now the suits are doing the corporate downgrade ladder and calling it "Novels Plus". Plus what? Plus whatever fan-fiction they cooked up on a lunch break?
We break down the good, the bad, and the genuinely cooked: from book-accurate eagle crests and proper Herbology lessons to John Lithgow sounding like an angry American high school football coach, Nick Frost’s Hagrid, blind bathroom trolls, and Lily and James apparently burning down bridges on date night. Is this actually going to honor the books, or are we staring down another corporate trainwreck like Google Plus?

Drop a comment below with your thoughts—is "Novels Plus" code for total disaster, or are you actually keen?

BECOME A MEMBER to hear the completely uncensored, filthy versions of every breakdown.

En esta sesión nos acompaña la leyenda del merengue, Wilfrido Vargas, para traernos un recorrido inolvidable por sus más grandes éxitos a puro ritmo y energía.

Sobre Free Cover
Free Cover es una banda nacida en Venezuela en 2017, fundada por el guitarrista Neg y el tecladista Chompa. La banda reúne a músicos y amigos unidos por la pasión por los grandes clásicos de nuestra música. Su premisa es sencilla pero poderosa: reinterpretar canciones que marcaron época con versiones honestas, bien tocadas y cuidadosamente grabadas.

Mala mía

Me dicen las babies que por andar bien loca ayer me boté
Pero bueno, me vale madre porque bien perro me la pasé
Y qué tiene, díganme qué tiene
Si en la loquera al de la puerta hasta un besito le regalé

Me vale madre, de lejos se me nota
No andamos a penitas, aquí feria es lo que sobra
La paso rico pues lo bandido no se me quita
Si no les gusta, pues es su pedo, así es mi vida

Me vale madre, qué verga les importa
Si andamos enfiestadas, un culito nunca estorba
Si ando en la calle, ve por tu morra pa’ que la escondas
Si te enamoras, pues es tu pedo, no tengo cora

No sé qué pasó ayer
Que se me borró el cassette
En el parche un cagadero con pura plebita de caché
Nos fuimos de alter y la pasamos bien
Y tomé tanto tanto que ando pedo todavía
Con el whiskacho y las Dom Peri, se hizo de día

Ando en la mía, no me pidan nada más ni nada menos
Hago lo que yo quiero
Ya no me digan nada, que no ando buscando consejos
Ni de pedo

Me dicen los plebes que por andar bien loco ayer me boté
Pero bueno, me vale verga, porque bien vergas me la pasé
Y qué tiene, díganme qué tiene
Si en la loquera a una culona el pinche Roly le regalé

Me vale madre, qué verga les importa
Si andamos enfiestadas, un culito nunca estorba
Si ando en la calle, ve por tu morra pa’ que la escondas
Si te enamoras, pues es tu pedo, no tengo cora

Me vale madre, de lejos se me nota
No andamos a penitas, aquí feria es lo que sobra
La paso rico pues lo bandido no se me quita
Si no les gusta, pues es su pedo, así es mi vida (ah-ah-ah)

Kenia Os (KOs, bebé)
Y su compa Xavi, mi viejo

In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms. snippet.title: Wake Island: The Last Stand That Stunned Japan
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0244

December 1941. It’s the early days of the Pacific War and Wake Island – a small atoll in the middle of the Pacific Ocean – is enduring daily raids by Japanese bombers. The defenders must rely on half-finished fortifications, outdated coastal guns, the four surviving planes of USMC Fighter Squadron 211, some AA guns that have AA directors, the help of civilian builders, and sheer determination. The poorly equipped but well-trained marines are busily preparing for the worst.

On December 11th, a Japanese landing force under Rear Admiral Kajioka sails closer to Wake Island, determined to obtain this atoll as a forward air base for the Imperial Japanese Navy. The bomber pilots have reported that over the last three days they have leveled the defences there, so not much resistance is to be expected.

Sources:
1. R. D. Heinl Jr. The Defense of Wake. U.S. Marine Corps, 1947
2. J. P. S. Devereux The Story of Wake Island. NY, 1947
3. R. J. Cressman A Magnificent Fight: Marines in the Battle for Wake Island. Naval Institute Press 1997
4. G. R. Cunningham Tactical Effectiveness of Naval Aviation at https://www.historycentral.com/navy/stories/Cuningham.html
5. https://www.history.navy.mil/research/library/online-reading-room/title-list-alphabetically/n/narrative-of-captain-ws-cunningham-us-navy-relative-to-events-o-wake-island-in-december-1941-and-subsequent-related-events.html
6. John F. Kinney, Wake Island Pilot: A World War II Memoir. Sterling, VA: Potomac Books, 2005

snippet.title: State of Play | September 3, 2026 [English]
snippet.description:
State of Play returns Thursday, September 3 with two broadcasts airing back-to-back.

First, tune in for a new State of Play featuring updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and our third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Immediately following, stay tuned for a new episode of State of Play Japan, once again hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will offer deep dives into upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

See you there.
Regarding co-streaming and video-on-demand (VOD)

Please note that this broadcast may include copyrighted content (e.g. licensed music) that Sony Interactive Entertainment does not control. snippet.title: I Joined Minecraft's Rich VS Poor Civilization [FULL MOVIE]
snippet.description:
Here in Rich VS Poor Civilization, you either live in poverty your whole life or get lucky and become rich. The only way to rank up and become rich is by finding a diamond. snippet.title: Bowser Destroyed Mario's Bike... But Mario's Revenge Was Unbelievable! 😱🏆 | Mario Story
snippet.description:
Bowser Destroyed Mario's Bike... But Mario's Revenge Was Unbelievable! 😱🏆 | Mario Story   ; https://youtu.be/Uc2dAFJbOt8 

Bowser destroyed Mario's bike and thought he had already won... But he made one huge mistake! 😱🔥

In this exciting Mario Story, Mario enters the legendary Neon Arena Race to challenge Bowser in an ultimate motorcycle battle. Racing through neon cities, dangerous portals, and fiery lava tracks, Mario tries everything to win.

But Bowser secretly uses a powerful electric device to sabotage Mario's bike! ⚡🏍️
Mario's motorcycle suffers a system failure, crashes on the dangerous track, and Bowser takes the victory while celebrating with Princess Peach.

Feeling defeated, Mario loses his confidence and hides away. But Luigi and Yoshi refuse to give up! 💪✨ They help Mario analyze the damaged bike and discover a way to build something much stronger.

Together, Mario, Luigi, and Yoshi travel to a mysterious sky kingdom to find a legendary energy core. With new technology, they create the incredible Cyber Bike 2.0 equipped with:

⚡ 100% Energy Shield
🚀 Maximum Speed Boost
🛡️ Anti-Electric Attack Protection
🔥 Ultimate Racing Power

Mario returns to the Neon Arena for the final rematch against Bowser. But this time, Bowser's tricks don't work anymore! Mario's upgraded Cyber Bike survives every attack and races across the stars on the legendary Rainbow Road.

Can Mario defeat Bowser and prove who is the true racing champion? 🏆🔥

Watch until the end to see Mario's incredible comeback, Bowser's shocking defeat, and a heartwarming reunion with Luigi and Yoshi!

⭐ Enjoy this amazing Mario Adventure Story full of action, friendship, racing, and unexpected twists!
